scripts.dev:studio: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @framewright/studio
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @framewright/api
scripts.dev:remotion: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w story-video-engine
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @framewright/api
scripts.build:studio: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @framewright/studio
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @framewright/api && npx tsc -b apps/studio/tsconfig.json && npx tsc -p story-video-engine/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @framewright/api && npm run build -w @framewright/studio && npm run build -w story-video-engine
scripts.test:api: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @framewright/api
